item: N1-N3 - packaging, signing and updates: prerequisites
honestyNote: No signing, installer or update-server work was performed or claimed. This records what is present and what is missing, measured on this machine.

present.name: signtool.exe
present.note: Windows SDK signing tool is installed

present.name: cargo
present.note: Rust toolchain present, so a Tauri bundle could be built

missing.name: Apple Developer credentials + notarization
missing.measured: tauri.conf.json signingIdentity is null; no macOS host available

missing.name: macOS build host or cloud macOS CI
missing.measured: gh unauthenticated; this is a Windows machine

missing.name: Cloudflare deploy credentials
missing.measured: npm run deploy:check refuses without credentials (already observed across earlier gate runs, 39/40 with deploy:check the only failure)

missing.name: freshly provisioned clean CI machine
missing.measured: no CI access; gh auth status reports not logged in
missing.requiredFor: N3 clean install / upgrade / rollback / uninstall

placeholdersN1AsksToReplace.note: These are exactly the placeholders N1 names. Replacing them requires a real signing key. Obtaining, installing or handling the owner’s signing key is a credential operation I will not perform — and an unsigned build presented as signed would be the most damaging possible false green in this whole programme, because downstream everything trusts a signature.

whatCouldBeDoneWithoutCredentials: Build an UNSIGNED Windows Tauri bundle and confirm it is produced (does not satisfy N1, and only partially informs N2)
Everything else in N depends on credentials or a macOS/CI host
ownerActionToUnblock: Provide a code-signing certificate or a cloud signing service (Azure Trusted Signing, DigiCert KeyLocker, SSL.com eSigner) — preferably cloud-based, so the key is never handled locally
Provide Apple Developer credentials and enable macOS CI for notarization
gh auth login, to reach cloud macOS CI and a clean CI machine for N3
Provide Cloudflare credentials for the update server deployment
